name: Bisi Bele Bath
steps: Wash rice and toor dal together.
Pressure cook with 5 cups water for 4 whistles.
Extract tamarind juice and set aside.
Chop vegetables into small pieces.
Boil vegetables in tamarind water with turmeric.
Mash the cooked rice-dal mixture.
Add mashed mixture to boiling vegetables.
Add bisi bele bath powder and salt.
Simmer for 10 minutes until thick.
Heat ghee, fry cashews and curry leaves.
Pour tempering over the bisi bele bath.
Serve hot with boondi or papad.

name: Akki Roti
steps: Take rice flour in a bowl.
Add finely chopped onions, green chillies, coriander.
Add grated carrot, grated coconut, cumin seeds.
Add salt and mix dry ingredients.
Add water little by little to make soft dough.
Take a portion, flatten on greased banana leaf or plastic.
Pat into thin circle using wet fingers.
Make a small hole in center.
Transfer onto hot griddle.
Drizzle oil around edges.
Cook on medium heat until golden on both sides.
Serve hot with coconut chutney.
